assignments.rationale: Guiding evaluative questions, calibrated evidential maturity, comparable categories, and condition-to-consequence reasoning fit model criticism's emphasis on diagnostics and qualified inference.
Single-decision focus, ordinary transitions, direct sentences, faithful treatment of supplied limitations, and concise restatement describe neutral editing rather than domain-specific judgment.

Ordered taxonomies, dense condition-mechanism-consequence-response chains, cumulative causal elaboration, and clause-stacked treatment of exceptions and consequences strongly fit system-safety analysis.
Tradeoff framing, partial agreement before narrow disagreement, explicit personal practice and uncertainty, compressed takeaways, and occasional informal analogy fit pragmatic engineering judgment.

limitations: The cards contain abstract register features rather than direct domain terminology, so the assignments are inferential and partially overlapping.
The packet defines no confidence scale; confidence uses 1 to mean a positive assignment rather than a calibrated probability.
